$comment: Machine-readable faction style bible. Read by tools/meshy/prompts.py. Human copy: docs/style-bible/<faction>.md. Draft until Luke approves gate A.

covenant.name: Iron Covenant
covenant.feel: cathedral knights, noble, upright and ornate
covenant.palette: black enamel plate (#262527), aged gold trim (#805830), crimson cloth (#800d14), bone ivory accents (#d2c5bb), amber furnace glow only at the visor and chest
covenant.motifs: gold filigree trim on every plate edge, sunburst pauldrons, cross and eagle heraldry on crimson cloth, a tabard hanging from the belt, cathedral spires and a banner standard on the back, a glowing furnace chest behind a gothic window, a slit visor under a pointed gothic helm, armoured hands
covenant.silhouette: tall and upright, broad shoulders, narrow waist, straight legs
covenant.joints: armoured plate collars, namely gauntlet cuffs, knee and elbow cops, a gorget at the neck, a belt at the waist
covenant.never: rust, stencilled numbers, exposed pipes or chains, teal, halos, hunched poses, bare thin rods

foundries.name: Ashen Foundries
foundries.feel: industrial warbands, brutal, hunched and functional, mass-produced and soot-stained
foundries.palette: rust red lacquered plate (#8d2912), orange lacquer panels (#be6a35), blackened iron (#34322f), worn brass fittings (#6e4d2f), orange furnace glow from vents and cores
foundries.motifs: riveted hull plates with stencilled white unit numbers, hazard stripes on plate edges, twin smokestacks, glowing furnace cores behind grilles, hydraulic pistons, ammunition belts and chains, welded patch plates, exposed pipes
foundries.silhouette: low, wide and hunched, heavy forearms and guns, big boxy shoulders
foundries.joints: chunky riveted collars and brass-sleeved hydraulic pistons, thick ball-and-socket hips and shoulders
foundries.never: gold filigree, cloth banners, tabards, halos, cathedral spires, teal, thin skeletal limbs, upright elegant poses

sentinel.silhouette: a gatehouse knight: broader and lower than a Paladin, deep chest, big sunburst pauldrons, thick armoured legs, wide stance, heavy slab-like shoulder plates
sentinel.weapons: a heavy rotary Carapace Gun on the right forearm (gilded barrel shroud, crimson ammunition drum) and an empty armoured left gauntlet that could carry a tower shield
sentinel.back: a tall banner standard with a crimson banner and gold cross finial, between two cathedral spires
sentinel.parts: legs, torso with pelvis, helm, pauldrons, arms, and the banner back, and the signature weapon

artillery.silhouette: a walking gun platform: a squat, hunched hull much wider than it is tall, a deep boxy torso, short thick legs set wide apart to take the recoil, heavy riveted shoulder plates, a small armoured head sunk between the shoulders
artillery.weapons: one very long howitzer barrel (riveted tube with a recoil sleeve and a muzzle brake) slung over the right shoulder on a gimbal cradle, and a heavy clamp hand on each arm, the left holding an artillery shell
artillery.back: the howitzer's gimbal cradle and a belt-fed ammunition drum, between two smokestacks
artillery.parts: legs, torso with pelvis, helm, pauldrons, arms, and the back with its howitzer, drum and smokestacks
